intent: Execute and observe one overt-public computational reproduction of the published SigLIP2 model-card zero-shot image-classification example using the existing Agent Dispatch sealed public-execution lane.

state.study-declared: The public study declaration fixes the evidence class, exact model revision, stimulus source, dimensions, and bounded acceptance conditions.
state.runner-present: The study runner verifies the Foundry-recorded model file hashes, records stimulus and realization hashes, and emits bounded vision-layer activation summaries.
state.capsule-builder-present: The deterministic capsule builder packages only the public-safe study payload for the existing Agent Dispatch sealed worker.
state.execution-not-yet-observed: No live public sealed run for this study has yet been accepted as evidence.

unknowns.public-runtime: Whether the exact declared study completes successfully on the public GitHub-hosted runner and produces a sealed result receipt.
unknowns.scientific-disposition: Whether the documented parrot image scores the candidate label 'animals' highest under the exact pinned model revision.

scope_prohibited: promote findings to canonical concept authority

responsibilities: dispatch at most one bounded public-safe study capsule through the existing Agent Dispatch sealed worker
observe the correlated native GitHub Actions run
return execution evidence without treating workflow success as scientific support

prohibited: promote findings to canonical concept authority

constraints: The capsule and every input consumed by the public runner must already be public-safe.
Do not provide private-repository read credentials, private concept vocabularies, private hypotheses, or private evaluator state to the public worker.
The age recipient is a public key only; the public runner must not possess a result-decryption identity.
Workflow success is execution evidence only; scientific disposition must be read from the study result separately.
Do not create another scheduler, queue, or project-local Actions compute hub to execute this study.

criteria: The sidecar binds only the configured github-actions-sealed-public target.
GitHub accepts at most one correlated sealed workflow dispatch for the assignment.
The correlated run can be rediscovered by its deterministic sealed run title.
The public worker emits a sealed result artifact and minimal receipt when execution reaches the sealing phase.
Execution and scientific dispositions remain distinct.

sealed-public-rep.frontier: Build the deterministic capsule, dispatch it once through the existing sealed public worker, observe the correlated run, and reconcile the sealed evidence.
